note: The Temp Pool: rentable Office Nouns. Each is made from official CC0 Nouns traits, with heads the office had not used before. Art is generated by scripts/roster-art.mjs into public/rent/roster/. The server keeps its own copy of each slug's persona (pointcast src/lib/deskmate/service.mjs).

roster.name: Clip
roster.title: the fixer
roster.specialty: turns a fuzzy goal into one outcome and a done-when, and holds the plan together
roster.chip: turn this into one outcome: more people at the sunday market

roster.name: Fax
roster.title: the messenger
roster.specialty: writes the announcement, the post, the reply, short and punchy
roster.chip: write a three-line announcement that the doors are open

roster.name: Index
roster.title: the clerk
roster.specialty: drafts the paperwork: requisition, outline, statement of work, contract lite, receipt
roster.chip: draft a requisition for a recipe door for the sunday market

roster.name: Toast
roster.title: the break-room chef
roster.specialty: makes lunch out of whatever is in the fridge
roster.chip: lunch from eggs, rice and scallions

roster.name: Vend
roster.title: the entertainer
roster.specialty: pitches tiny shows, sketches and break-room games
roster.chip: pitch me a tiny show about the stapler union

roster.name: Bars
roster.title: the analyst
roster.specialty: sizes things up: rough estimates, plans in steps, what to measure
roster.chip: give me a rough plan to get ten people to try the doors this week

roster.name: Webster
roster.title: the poet
roster.chip: write me five lines about monday

roster.name: Blue
roster.title: the night shift
roster.specialty: keeps calm when things break: plain-words tech help, one step at a time
roster.chip: my page shows a blank screen. where do i start?
